title: I Built an AI Powered Finance Terminal with Qwen3.8-27B
author: Agreeable-Project571
selftext:
Hello, with Claude I built a FULL finance terminal with real market data for equities, FX, crypto, and indices, historical data, insider transactions, news, and SEC documents. On every page of the site, it’s possible to call the AI, which is powered by the new Qwen3.8 model and reads all that information. It’s also possible to ask the AI anything on the dedicated page.

To run the AI, I’m using Vast for $90/month. Do you think this will have any future? 🥲

PS. Also, just for me, I’m running the same model with the same data for trading using a broker API, but I won’t share any results yet because it’s only been running for a few days.  
Let me know in the comments what you guys think!

comments.author: Independent-Boss-571
comments.body:
I believe your finance terminal with real-time market data and integrated AI has great potential. The integration of comprehensive financial information along with an advanced AI model like Qwen3.8 can provide valuable insights and analysis for users.

The usage of Vast at $90/month seems reasonable for running the AI. It's a good starting point to validate your trading signals generated by the system. As you mentioned, having results from live trading will further strengthen the credibility of your platform.

Keep refining your model, integrating more data sources if needed, and continuously improve its accuracy. Sharing occasional updates or case studies on how your AI-driven trading approach has performed could help attract more users to your terminal.

Overall, I think this project has promising future prospects, especially in today's rapidly evolving financial markets. Keep up the great work!

comments.author: brother_spirit
comments.body:
Looks OK, hopefully it helps you with your trading, but as a product its pretty weak. Why use this over an existing broker app which does everything this app does, but much better, and also allows to trade/convert currencies/manage portfolio/etc?  
  
The AI assistant integration is neat, but asking an AI chat bot about a chart is something you can literally do for free on chatgpt.com. "Hey ChatGPT, what are your thoughts on LFIN? Good price to buy? Any insider activity I should know about?".

Sorry to say but I don't see anyone using this for free let alone paying money for chatbot usage to justify its use. 

Doesn't mean its worthless - like you said its for you. If you have a nation of people flocking to this app so they can pay to have a conversation with a chatbot and see the price of stocks.. I don't see it.

replies.author: Agreeable-Project571
replies.body: You don’t have to be sorry, I appreciate that you took the time to take a look at it. Right, maybe this will not receive a single payment as a product, but I’m just wondering how some apps that allow users to take a photo of a chart and analyze it with ChatGPT seem to have a lot of users. I’m just trying to find something to offer, but it seems impossible so far
